svg.title: Tailwhip schematic
svg.text: Tailwhip electronics schematic (robot). Net labels with the same name are connected.
All grounds common. R1 100k, R2 33k, R3 R4 100k (1 %), C1 470 uF 16 V low-ESR, C2 100 nF. Both Mini360 bucks set to 5.0 V with a meter BEFORE anything is connected.
no enable pins: PWM on the INs
Power the IR modules from 3.3 V: their D0 pull-up goes to VCC.
own Wi-Fi stream; no wires to U5
Motor current flows BMS -> F1 -> SW1 -> MX1508: 22 AWG.
Slow decay: one IN held high, the other PWM-ed (brake
in the off-time). Average motor V = duty x VBAT.
Firmware caps the average at 6.0 V (u = 1).
U1 feeds only logic: a servo stall cannot reset U5.
Charge with SW1 OFF through J1 (8.4 V CC/CV, 1 A).
